Specification of Diagnostic Event Manager
AUTOSAR CP R20-11
7.3.1 Event priority
Event priority is defined as a ranking of events based upon level of importance. It is
used to determine which fault entries may be removed from the
event memory
in
case the number of stored events exceeds the maximum number of memory entries
(event memory is full).
[SWS_Dem_00382]
⌈
Each supported event shall have a priority assigned to it (re-
fer to parameter
DemDTCPriority
in
DemDTCAttributes
).
⌋
(RS_Diag_04118, RS_-
Diag_04071)
[SWS_Dem_00383]
⌈
A priority value of 1 shall be the highest priority. Larger priority
value shall define lower importance.
⌋
(RS_Diag_04118, RS_Diag_04071)
7.3.2 Event occurrence
[SWS_Dem_00011]
⌈
The Dem module shall provide an occurrence counter per
event
memory entry
.
⌋
(RS_Diag_04067)
[SWS_Dem_00523]
⌈
The Dem module shall initialize the occurrence counter with the
value one if the related event is entered in the respective
event memory
.
⌋
(RS_Diag_-
04067)
[SWS_Dem_00524]
⌈
If the configuration parameter
DemOccurrenceCounterPro-
cessing
is set to
DEM_PROCESS_OCCCTR_TF
(refer to
DemPrimaryMemory
or
De-
mUserDefinedMemory
), the Dem module shall increment the occurrence counter by
one, triggered by each
UDS status bit 0
(TestFailed) transition from 0 to 1, if the
related event is already stored in the
event memory
.
⌋
(RS_Diag_04067)
[SWS_Dem_00580]
⌈
If the configuration parameter
DemOccurrenceCounterPro-
cessing
is set to
DEM_PROCESS_OCCCTR_CDTC
(refer to
DemPrimaryMemory
or
DemUserDefinedMemory
), the Dem module shall increment the occurrence counter
by one, triggered by each
UDS status bit 0
transition from 0 to 1, if the related
event is already stored in the
event memory
and the
UDS status bit 3
is equal
to 1 (refer to chapter 0).
⌋
(RS_Diag_04105)
[SWS_Dem_00625]
⌈
The Dem module shall not increment the event-specific oc-
currence counter anymore, if it has reached its maximum value (255, refer to
[SWS_Dem_00471]).
⌋
(RS_Diag_04125)
